calculation_handling.description: Scope statement: Article 10.10.40 applies to buildings or structures in the R zone other than ancillary buildings or structures, which are governed by Articles 10.5.60 and 10.10.60.
calculation_handling.gaps: Scope only; excludes ancillary_building from Article 10.10.40 units.

calculation_handling.description: For 10.10.40.1(9), lawful / lawfully existing also includes buildings, structures or uses authorized or permitted on or before June 26, 2025, and those for which a building permit was lawfully issued before June 26, 2025.
calculation_handling.gaps: Term definition for the bedroom transition rule; zone keyed from article context (no zone phrase in the unit).

calculation_handling.description: Defines a 'request for a zoning certificate' by reference to Municipal Code Chapter 363, Article I.
calculation_handling.gaps: Procedural definition; no DSL variable.

calculation_handling.description: Defines a 'complete application for a zoning by-law amendment' by reference to Official Plan Policy 5.5.2.
calculation_handling.gaps: Procedural definition; no DSL variable.

calculation_handling.description: Defines a 'complete application for a minor variance' by reference to Section 2 of O. Reg. 200/96.
calculation_handling.gaps: Procedural definition; no DSL variable.

calculation_handling.description: Defines a 'complete application for site plan approval' by reference to Official Plan Policy 5.5.2.
calculation_handling.gaps: Procedural definition; no DSL variable.

calculation_handling.description: A maximum of one residential building is permitted on a lot in the R zone.
calculation_handling.gaps: Counts residential buildings only; building_types 'any' because the clause names no specific type. Displaced by (2)(B) on a lot abutting a major street for townhouses and apartment buildings.

calculation_handling.description: Despite (2)(A), more than one townhouse or apartment building, or combination, is permitted on a lot abutting a major street.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces the one-building limit of (2)(A) for townhouses and apartment buildings on major-street lots.

calculation_handling.description: If the lot's zone label has the letter u, the number after u is the maximum number of dwelling units on the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: none

calculation_handling.description: Despite (3)(A), an apartment building on a lot abutting a major street may have the greater of 60 dwelling units or the label u value.
calculation_handling.gaps: Apartment buildings are outside the core MaxBLD types (detached/semi/row) but the limit is fully expressible.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum width of a townhouse dwelling unit is 5.0 metres if the unit does not have an individual private driveway leading directly to its front.
calculation_handling.gaps: The applying condition is the NEGATION of the individual_private_driveway token, which the condition grammar cannot express (not applies only to atoms), so condition is left none; it must be read together with (4)(B), which applies 6.0 m when the unit has such a driveway. The target is the width of one townhouse dwelling unit, keyed as building_width_m.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum width of a townhouse dwelling unit is 6.0 metres in all other cases, i.e. where the unit has an individual private driveway leading directly to its front.
calculation_handling.gaps: 'In all other cases' read as the unit having an individual private driveway; whether it does is a design input.

calculation_handling.description: A building, or a detached addition, with dwelling units is not permitted in the rear of another building or of the original part of the same building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Site layout of multiple buildings is not modelled; MaxBLD assumes one principal building fronting the street.

units.disclosure: A building with dwelling units cannot be placed behind another building on the lot (except townhouses or apartments on a major street); not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A building, or a detached addition, is not permitted in front of a building with dwelling units so as to put a building with dwelling units in the rear of another building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Site layout of multiple buildings is not modelled.

units.disclosure: A new building cannot be placed in front of an existing building with units so that the units end up at the rear; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: (5)(A) and (5)(B) do not apply to townhouses or apartment buildings on a lot abutting a major street.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces 10.10.40.1(5)(A) and (5)(B) for those types on major-street lots.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 900.1.10(3) and (4)(A), where a detached houseplex is the only residential building on the lot and the applicable Chapter 900 exception has principal building requirements for a detached house, the houseplex is subject to those detached-house exception requirements.
calculation_handling.gaps: Maps exception requirements written for detached house onto detached houseplex; the 'only residential building on a lot' condition has no vocab token. Zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: On a lot with a site-specific exception, a detached houseplex follows the exception's rules for a detached house; exceptions are not yet evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 900.1.10(3) and (4)(A), where a semi-detached houseplex is the only residential building on the lot and the applicable Chapter 900 exception has principal building requirements for a semi-detached house, the houseplex is subject to those requirements for the portion of a semi-detached house that is an individual dwelling unit.
calculation_handling.gaps: Maps exception requirements for semi-detached house onto semi-detached houseplex; 'only residential building' condition has no vocab token. Zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: On a lot with a site-specific exception, a semi-detached houseplex follows the exception's rules for a semi-detached house; exceptions are not yet evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.10.40.1(6), 900.1.10(3) and (4)(A), if a regulation in 10.10.40.10, 10.10.40.30 or 10.10.40.40 for a detached or semi-detached houseplex is more permissive than the one that would apply under (6), the more permissive regulation prevails.
calculation_handling.gaps: Base prevails over exception only where more permissive, per regulation (height, depth, FSI); a plain layer ranking cannot express 'more permissive wins'. Zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: For houseplexes, if the regular R-zone height, depth or density rule is more generous than the site exception, the generous rule applies; exceptions are not yet evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: In a detached or semi-detached houseplex with two dwelling units, the maximum number of bedrooms is four times the number of dwelling units.
calculation_handling.gaps: Stem text reads 'semi- detached houseplex' in the heading. A bachelor unit counts as one bedroom per (8)(C).

calculation_handling.description: In a detached or semi-detached houseplex with three or more dwelling units, the maximum number of bedrooms is three times the number of dwelling units.
calculation_handling.gaps: The multiplier 'three' and the threshold 'three or more' are the same word in the text; the first binds the expression, the second the condition.

calculation_handling.description: For counting bedrooms under (8)(A) and (B), a bachelor dwelling unit has one bedroom.
calculation_handling.gaps: Counting rule applied to the bedroom_count user input.

calculation_handling.description: A houseplex may exceed the (8) bedroom maximum if it is a lawfully existing residential building and no bedrooms are added that increase the noncompliance after June 26, 2025.
calculation_handling.gaps: Transition rule for existing buildings; zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: An existing houseplex with more bedrooms than now allowed may keep them if none are added after June 26, 2025; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A houseplex built under a permit issued after June 26, 2025 may exceed the (8) bedroom maximum if its bedrooms per unit do not exceed those identified in a zoning certificate, zoning by-law amendment, minor variance or site plan approval whose request or complete application was filed on or before June 26, 2025.
calculation_handling.gaps: Requires application-filing history we do not hold; zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: Projects with applications filed on or before June 26, 2025 may keep their approved bedroom counts; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: For a building constructed under (9)(B), no bedrooms may be added after the founding building permit if they would increase the noncompliance beyond that permit.
calculation_handling.gaps: Requires permit history; zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: Bedrooms cannot be added beyond what the transitional permit allowed; not evaluated.

10.10.40.1(1).explanation: The R-zone building rules in this article apply to main buildings; garages, sheds and other ancillary buildings follow separate rules.

10.10.40.1(10).explanation: Definitions used by the bedroom transition rule: what counts as lawfully existing (permitted or permitted by June 26, 2025) and what counts as a complete application or zoning certificate request.

10.10.40.1(2).explanation: Only one residential building is allowed on an R-zone lot, except that several townhouse or apartment buildings may share a lot that abuts a major street.

10.10.40.1(3).explanation: If the lot's zone label has a 'u' number, that is the maximum number of units. An apartment building on a major street may have at least 60 units, or the 'u' number if higher.

10.10.40.1(4).explanation: Each townhouse unit must be at least 5.0 metres wide, or 6.0 metres if it has its own driveway leading to its front.

10.10.40.1(5).explanation: A building with units cannot sit behind another building on the lot, and a building cannot be put in front of one with units, except townhouses or apartment buildings on a major street. Not evaluated.

10.10.40.1(6).explanation: If a site-specific exception has rules for detached or semi-detached houses, a houseplex of the same form follows those rules. Exceptions are not yet evaluated.

10.10.40.1(7).explanation: For houseplexes, if the regular R-zone height, depth or density rule is more generous than what the site exception would give, the more generous rule applies.

10.10.40.1(8).explanation: A houseplex may have up to 4 bedrooms per unit with two units, or 3 per unit with three or more units. A bachelor unit counts as one bedroom.

10.10.40.1(9).explanation: Existing houseplexes, and projects with applications filed by June 26, 2025, may keep more bedrooms than the new limit, but cannot add more. Not evaluated.
